iterations.draft_explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis table provides performance metrics (R² and MSE) for various combinations of features added sequentially. For the KNN model, the performance improves as more features are added up to 9 features, where it records an R² of 0.8301 and an MSE of 0.0119. When all 11 features are included, the KNN model maintains a high R² of 0.8178 and an MSE of 0.01276. Comparing the final results across all features, the summary text indicates that the KNN model achieved the best overall performance with R² = 0.81717 and MSE = 0.012810 when all 11 features were used. The table data supports this trend, showing consistently high performance for KNN as features are added, peaking at 9 features in the table, and remaining very strong at 11 features.
